English: Grand Bath Facility
A monumental, marble-clad palace of healing waters and aromatic steams legendary for its comfort, prestige, and contributions to science and health.
Grand Healing Garden
A legendary, labyrinthine garden combining medicinal, botanical, and scholarly wonders visited by famed healers, scholars, and nobles seeking cures, inspiration, and prestige.
Steamed Bathhouse
Inspired by eastern innovations, this advanced bathhouse uses heated stones and controlled steam to cleanse and invigorate all who enter.
Grand Provision Depot
A monumental stone complex with advanced ventilation, dedicated staff, and secure archives ensuring unmatched stability and prestige.
Advanced Cookery

A state-of-the-art medieval kitchen, blending culinary innovation with rigorous cleanliness, supporting research into nutrition and the culinary arts. Its staff serve as a model for kitchens throughout the realm.
Advanced Aqueduct Network

An interconnected marvel of stone, pipes, and filtration, this aqueduct system delivers pure water across the entire hospital complex and influences the province beyond, attracting scholars and healers alike.
Sanitary Patient Wing
A luxurious and meticulously clean wing for the sick, with flowing water, tiled floors, and advanced care.
Orchard Annex
A sprawling orchard of medicinal trees and fruit, supplementing the hospital's larder and providing rare ingredients for both healing and experimental remedies.
Sanitary Laundry Facility
A state-of-the-art complex, featuring advanced sanitation, filtered water, and strict protocols, serving as a model for cleanliness and innovation.
Indoor Bath Hall
A vast, covered hall with flowing water, advanced drainage, and a dedicated staff a marvel of medieval hygiene and engineering.
Climate-Controlled Store
A marvel of passive engineering: thick walls, underground passages, and ice cellars to preserve even the most delicate supplies.
Spacious Kitchen Hall
A grand hall for meal preparation and communal dining, with ample space for large-scale cooking, storage, and safe food distribution during crises.
Advanced Surgery Hall
A grand hall for complex procedures, equipped with advanced tools, observation galleries for students, and sophisticated sanitation measures.
Pressurized Water Supply
Complex mechanisms and sealed pipes provide pressurized water throughout the hospital, supporting advanced sanitation and research.
Mechanical Washing Shed
A marvel of proto-industry, equipped with waterwheel-driven beaters and wringers, vastly increasing throughput and cleanliness.
Expanded Medicinal Garden
Vast, meticulously arranged plots teeming with diverse medicinal flora, attended by trained herbalists, feeding both the hospital's needs and scholarly study.
Multiple Well System
A network of independent wells ensures redundancy and protects the hospital from drought and sabotage, enhancing overall reliability and prestige.
Spacious Infirmary Hall
A grand hall with vaulted ceilings and ample room for patients, staff, and scholars to study medicine.
Advanced Apothecary

The pinnacle of medieval medical achievement: an advanced apothecary, complete with laboratories, libraries, and rare gardens. Here, the synthesis of knowledge and practice produces wonders, and the sick are treated with the utmost care.
Separate Bath Pools
Multiple stone pools for segregated bathing, reducing the spread of infection and supporting longer hospital stays.
Separate Entrance Wing
A new wing with its own entrance diverts the flow of patients and physicians, reducing the risk of contamination for the main hospital and the greater populace.
Expanded Storage Hall
A grand hall with vaulted ceilings and internal divisions, capable of supporting vast supplies and scholarly archives.
Stone Walled Garden
An expertly constructed medicinal garden, protected by high stone walls to shelter rare plants from harsh winds and theft, and to create a microclimate for advanced healing.
Pharmaceutical Hall

A grand stone hall, filled with marble counters and towering shelves, where master apothecaries oversee the production and distribution of sophisticated medicines. It serves as a center for medical scholarship and civic pride.
Lighted Surgery Suite
A well-lit, purpose-built surgical suite with polished stone, ample windows, and lanterns. Allows more precise procedures at all hours.
Oven Room
A specialized room with a large brick oven, allowing for baking bread and roasting in quantity. Greatly increases nutrition and morale for patients and staff alike.
Filtered Water Room
This chamber uses sand, gravel, and charcoal to filter and purify water before distribution, drastically minimizing the risk of waterborne illness.
Water Channel Laundry
A sophisticated network of stone channels and sluices, bringing fresh water directly to the laundry and carrying away waste.
Stone Bathhouse
A grand stone structure with tiled floors and masonry pools, offering lasting hygiene, safety, and a boost to local reputation.
Airflow Chamber
Architecturally designed rooms with high windows and air shafts, ensuring the continuous movement of fresh air to expel miasma and contagion.
Heated Infirmary
An advanced building with stone hearths and hypocaust ducts, ensuring warmth and reducing winter mortality.
Sanitized Quarantine Complex
A sprawling, meticulously cleaned complex with running water, lime-washed walls, and a dedicated staff of physicians and scholars an unmatched bulwark against disease and a beacon of learning.
Secured Supply Vault
A fortified, lockable vault with reinforced doors and guard access, ensuring safe storage of vital provisions.
Water Basin Room
A chamber dedicated to washing hands, tools, and wounds, with running water or large basins. Improves hygiene for staff and patients alike.
Timber Greenhouse
A timber-framed glasshouse, rare and costly, using oiled parchment or primitive glass to protect valuable herbs and accelerate growth even in poor weather.
Guarded Isolation Hall
A fortified hall patrolled by guards, ensuring the complete containment of the most dangerous patients and preventing any breach of quarantine.
Ventilated Kitchen
An advanced kitchen with careful airflow management, separate stations for food types, and staff trained in hygiene. Significantly reduces disease transmission and further improves efficiency.
Expanded Washing Hall
A grand hall accommodating many workers and patients' linens, with improved organization and waste disposal.
Covered Water Reservoir
A large, stone-covered reservoir stores and protects vast quantities of water, further reducing disease risk and supporting greater hospital operations.
Enlarged Cookhouse
A broad and well-ventilated cookhouse, staffed by skilled cooks and equipped for mass meal preparation, enabling the hospital to serve larger numbers with greater efficiency.
Stone Dispensary
A stone-walled dispensary with secure storage for rare and potent ingredients. The stone construction greatly improves hygiene and fire safety, and signals the hospital's growing prestige.
Master Surgeon's Theatre
A lavish amphitheater for surgical demonstration and instruction, attended by the realm's finest healers. Sets the standard for medical care and learning across the land.
Sealed Quarters
Double-gated entryways and heavy masonry seal infected rooms, with prepared barriers of lime and pitch. Air, servants, and supplies are strictly regulated.
Heated Bath Chamber
A refined timber complex with stone hearths, circulating hot air and water for superior comfort and improved disease prevention.
Separate Grain Room
A dedicated, raised granary chamber with specialized bins, fully sealed against pests and moisture.
Expanded Ward
Wards are enlarged and improved with additional cots, orderly spaces, and rudimentary sanitation.
Multi-Room Quarantine
A network of individually sealed and serviced rooms, each with their own staff and supply lines, allowing for flexible, large-scale containment of outbreaks.
Stone Surgery Chamber
A permanent stone-walled chamber, more easily cleaned and isolated, with thick doors to keep out drafts and pests. Markedly improves sterility and patient outcomes.
Raised Garden Beds
Engineered, wood-framed raised beds for optimal soil drainage, built alongside walkways for easy tending and efficient gathering of medicinal plants.
Stone Laundry
A solid building of mortared stone, with tiled floors, drainage, and ventilation, providing robust sanitary facilities.
Herbal Drying Room
A purpose-built chamber for the controlled drying and preservation of rare herbs, greatly enhancing the potency and shelf-life of medicines. Outfitted with improved ventilation and shelving.
Compounding Room
A specialized chamber for the precise compounding of advanced medicines and elixirs. Furnished with imported tools and run by skilled apothecaries, it attracts scholars and patients from afar.
Separate Pantry
A detatched, secure storehouse for foodstuffs, preserving provisions from vermin and spoilage. Ensures a reliable supply and helps prevent famine and disease.
Aqueduct Channel
A brick and stone aqueduct channel draws water from distant sources, greatly improving both quantity and cleanliness for the hospital.
Storied Pharmacy

A multi-storied edifice bustling with activity, housing vast stores of medicines, records, and herbariums. Its renown draws healers and learned men, fostering medical innovation and regional stability.
Stone Kitchen
A sturdy stone-built kitchen with proper chimney and slate floor, greatly reducing fire risk and ensuring cleaner preparation. Allows for more advanced food storage and preparation.
Ventilated Storehouse
A substantial building featuring cross-ventilation, brick floors, and multiple chambers for segregating perishables.
Timber Bathhouse
A sturdy wooden structure enclosing multiple tubs and benches, enhancing both hygiene and morale for all within the hospital.
Stone Isolation Room
Sturdy stone-walled cells, each carefully ventilated and separated, allow for rigorous isolation and improved hygiene. The first step toward truly effective quarantine.
Ventilated Ward
Wards equipped with advanced ventilation, minimizing miasma and improving patient outcomes.
Sterile Cloth Storage
A ventilated storeroom for boiled linens, carefully protected from vermin and dust. Ensures a ready supply of clean bandages and dressings.
Basic Instrument Store
A secured chest or closet for storing crude but essential surgical implements, keeping them cleaner and more easily accessible for procedures.
Stone Infirmary
A solid stone building with thick walls, providing security and improved isolation for the sick.
Irrigated Herb Patch
A carefully engineered herb garden with primitive irrigation ditches, enabling the cultivation of rare and potent herbs in quantity.
Apothecary Workshop
A dedicated workshop for the preparation of complex medicines, featuring stone mortars, drying racks, and a small staff. Here, knowledge is exchanged and experimentation flourishes.
Heated Drying Room
A purpose-built chamber with brick ovens and racks, allowing rapid drying of linens even in winter.
Isolated Recovery Room
Specialized chambers designed to quarantine patients, with strict protocols to contain contagion.
Bucket Pulley Well
A mechanical pulley system allows for easier and safer water retrieval, increasing supply and decreasing cross-contamination.
Stone Storeroom
A sturdy stone chamber with improved airflow and rodent-proofing, maintaining better hygiene for stored goods.
Timber Kitchen
A wooden kitchen structure with basic workbenches and racks, providing shelter for staff and provisions, improving meal quality and hygiene.
Hot Water Tub
A basic but ingenious system of heating water over fire, providing hot baths for greater comfort and cleanliness.
Soap-Making Nook
A small annex for the production of coarse soap, improving cleanliness and offering rudimentary study of hygiene.
Timber Surgery Room
A primitive but enclosed wooden structure, protecting patients and staff from the elements and livestock, with a dedicated space for procedures.
Timber Dispensary
A sturdier wooden structure for the organized storage and distribution of medicines, staffed by apprentice apothecaries. Improved cleanliness and record-keeping reduce risk of contamination.
Timber Laundry Room
A walled structure of wooden planks, providing a dedicated and secure space for hospital laundry.
Timber Isolation Room
Separate timber-walled chambers, each with a single cot, improve containment and allow for isolation of the critically ill. Straw bedding and barred doors keep the worst diseases at bay.
Fenced Garden Plot
A larger, sturdy fenced area for cultivating a wider array of medicinal herbs, with rudimentary paths and some organized irrigation.
Timber Infirmary
A wooden structure with divided cots, offering basic care and rudimentary isolation for the afflicted.
Dry Goods Closet
A modest, lockable closet with wooden shelves, improving organization and protection for sensitive supplies.
Stone-Lined Well
A deep, stone-lined well keeps groundwater clean and cool, providing a steady source of potable water for the hospital and its staff.
Covered Hearth
A crude timber and thatch awning over the cookfire, reducing exposure and smoke, improving food safety and allowing for limited storage of supplies.
Covered Washing Area
A rudimentary shelter of timber and canvas, shielding the wash basins and workers from rain and sun.
Wooden Bath Shed
A simple wooden shelter with basic bathing tubs, offering some privacy and improved hygiene for recovering patients and staff.
Simple Apothecary
A wooden shack with earthen floor, where basic potions and poultices are brewed for the sick. Humble, but invaluable to the frontier community.
Curtained Surgery Area
Simple linen curtains hung from ropes, providing privacy and some separation from dust and onlookers. Slightly reduces risk of spreading disease.
Sheltered Lean-to
A sturdier shelter, built with simple wooden supports and thatching to protect patients from the elements.
Timber Storage Shed
A simple wooden structure to keep supplies off the damp ground, offering some protection from weather and vermin.
Enclosed Herb Bed
A tidy, wattle-fenced bed, protected from trampling and wild beasts, allowing more delicate and useful medicinal plants to thrive near the hospital.
Curtained Cubicle
Canvas curtains and rope divide the sickbeds into crude cubicles, offering a modest degree of privacy and slightly reducing the spread of disease among patients.
Cookfire Pit
A simple fire pit ringed by stones, providing basic cooking for the sick and staff. Barely sheltered from the elements, it is the most rudimentary of kitchens.
Timber Well Cover
A wooden cover built over a shallow well, protecting water from contamination and light debris. Provides better water quality and slightly improves supply.
Washing Basin
A simple wooden basin for washing linens and garments, set on a stone or earth platform near the hospital.
Herbalist's Corner
A humble tent or lean-to, where local herbs are gathered and basic remedies are prepared by a resident herbalist. The first line of defense against local maladies.
Wooden Procedure Table
A rough-hewn timber table, hastily assembled for basic treatments in a field tent or earthwork shelter. Offers only rudimentary improvement to surgical capacity and minimal protection from infection.
Makeshift Sickbay
A rough shelter built from canvas, timber, and scavenged tools to treat the sick in dire circumstances.
Washing Area
A modest, open space with barrels and buckets for basic personal hygiene and washing of wounds. A vital first step for any frontier hospital.
Screened Sickbed
A hastily assembled sickbed, shielded by simple screens of wood and cloth to provide basic separation from the healthy. The most rudimentary attempt at containment
Supply Nook
A modest earthen pit or covered nook for basic provisions, hastily constructed from available materials.
Patch of Herbs
A simple clearing in the earth, where basic healing herbs are cultivated in rough beds for immediate use by the hospital's caretakers.
Rainwater Barrel
A simple barrel set beneath the eaves, collecting rainwater for immediate use. Improves basic water availability and slightly reduces disease risk.
